description: 15-min opening range breakout. Wait for first candle, mark range, enter on 5-min breakout + pullback.
source: YouTube short — 10 years in 1 minute strategy

steps.1_wait: 15:30-15:45 Oslo — DO NOT TRADE. Let first 15-min candle form.
steps.2_mark_range: At 15:45 — record HIGH and LOW of first 15-min candle for each top 30 mover.
steps.3_watch_breakout: 15:45-16:15 — every 5 min, check if 5-min candle CLOSED above range_high (BUY) or below range_low (SELL).
steps.4_enter_pullback: After breakout confirmed — enter on pullback to the range level (support/resistance).
steps.5_stop: Below range_low (for longs) or above range_high (for shorts).
steps.6_target: 2x stop distance or next major level.

key_difference: Does NOT enter at market open. Waits 15 min for range to form. Avoids the spike-and-crash problem.
